title: Strengthen ReactAgent execution guidance
summary:
Improved ReactAgent’s persistent system guidance to make tool-driven actions more reliable.

- Reinforced mutation fidelity and verification of required postconditions.
- Added lookup-first handling for ambiguity and requester roles.
- Expanded prompt-composition assertions to verify guidance placement and delivery.

The changes improved the targeted failing outcome while preserving results in the other evaluated scenarios. Tests were not run as instructed.
